events.title: British colony and the Jamaica dependency
hints: A 1670 treaty between two European crowns gave one of them the three small islands.
English settlers and enslaved Africans lived by turtling, fishing and seafaring.
From 1863 the islands were administered as a dependency of a larger colony until 1962.
events.summary: England gained the islands by the 1670 Treaty of Madrid. They were never developed into plantation colonies, but settlers used enslaved Africans for labour. They were a dependency of Jamaica from 1863 until Jamaica became independent in 1962.
